source.title: [Design proposal] Prospect Intelligence — store audits, business contacts & sales handoff
source.body:
# Design proposal — CartShift Prospect Intelligence (review requested)

**Status:** proposed architecture, **not approved for implementation**. No automated prospect messages, scans, data imports, or deployments are authorized by this issue.  
**Business context:** support a 30-day €5,000 collections objective; prioritize a revenue-producing pilot over a large engineering project.  
**Owner:** CartShift Studio. **Primary operator:** sales manager (Adi), with technical approval by founder.

## 1. Problem & outcomes

Today CartShift has: (a) a public Store Analyzer, (b) inbound marketing leads in `marketing_leads`, (c) agency/client portal and proposals, and (d) an existing manually researched prospect spreadsheet (14 Israeli candidates as of 2026-10-08). It does **not** have a distinct, evidence-backed *outbound prospect* workflow with business-contact discovery and channel-eligibility controls. Asking a nontechnical sales manager to diagnose Liquid/UX issues before selling is a bottleneck.

**Desired operator journey:** import/enter store → lightweight public-domain audit → evidence review → identify suitable business role/public contact → legal/consent review → hand off to Adi → discovery → founder-approved scoped proposal → won/lost/paid attribution.

**Success measures for pilot (targets, not projections):** 20–30 *consented/manual approved-for-scan* Israeli business domains; 5–8 meaningful verified findings; ≥5 leads with a valid next action; 3 discovery conversations; 1 scoped proposal. Track actual consent/channel review and cash collected, not just scan counts.

## 2. Findings in current repo (main as inspected 2026-10-14)

- Public scan orchestration: `lib/services/analyzer.ts`, `lib/services/scraper.ts`, `lib/utils/safe-store-fetch.ts`, `app/api/analyze-store/route.ts` (120s maxDuration).
- Existing inbound/self-submitted marketing: `lib/services/portal-marketing.ts`, `lib/services/store-analysis-leads.ts`, `app/[locale]/portal/agency/leads/MarketingLeadsClient.tsx`, `marketing_leads` and `marketing_email_jobs`.
- Agency authorization: `lib/auth/server-agency.ts`, `lib/utils/permissions.ts`, `firestore.rules`; `sales_manager` already exists.
- CRM/client handoff: `lib/types/portal.ts` (Organization has CRM contact fields), `portal_organizations`; agency proposals/requests already exist.
- React Query hooks in `lib/hooks`; localization sources `messages/src/en/...` and `messages/src/he/...`; never edit generated translations.

**Architectural constraint:** do not put researched companies into `marketing_leads`: this collection has an email requirement, inbound attribution/consent semantics, existing email jobs, and its scoring does not represent buying intent. Do not auto-create portal clients or invitations while prospecting.

## 3. Options & decision proposal

A. Spreadsheet + manual audit, no product work: cheapest/faster, poor process visibility.  
B. **Recommended:** thin, separate `agency_prospects` domain inside existing Agency Portal; reuse approved analyzer primitives and proposals; human-reviewed business-contact workflow. Best incremental value/cost.  
C. New autonomous crawler + contact enrichment + mass outreach: expensive, harder to audit, greater legal/privacy risk. **Defer**.

Ship B in vertical slices with A as the first-week pilot fallback. No new paid enrichment subscriptions, recurring scan scheduler, or new CRM service in MVP.

## 4. UX / roles

- New Agency Portal route `/[locale]/portal/agency/prospects` with list (status, brand, issue confidence, source, owner, last verified, next action), filters, and detail page.
- Prospect detail tabs: **Overview**, **Findings & Evidence**, **Business Contacts**, **Activity & Compliance**. Prominent empty/unknown evidence states; no fabricated impact estimates.
- Adi (`sales_manager`): read and triage, add discovery notes, select business-contact path, request technical review, update sales activity. May draft but not send unsolicited messages via app.
- Founder (`owner/admin`): approve finding, technical feasibility, estimate, proposal, relationship status, contact-channel eligibility/legal basis, suppression override policy. Suppression **cannot** be overridden into an automatic send.
- Client users have **zero** access. Agency developers/viewers have no access by default; explicitly grant roles only if needed.
- On qualification, link to existing proposal/agency-client workflow; do not duplicate proposal/payment logic. Conversion must preserve `prospectId` provenance.

## 5. Proposed data model (Firestore, non-public)

`agency_prospects/{prospectId}`
```ts
type ProspectStage = 'new'|'needs_review'|'qualified'|'contact_research'|'contact_ready'|'in_conversation'|'proposal'|'won'|'lost'|'suppressed';
type OutreachEligibility = 'unknown'|'review_required'|'consent_recorded'|'existing_relationship'|'approved_partner_channel'|'blocked';
type Prospect = {
  id: string; canonicalDomain: string; storeUrl: string; brandName: string;
  country: 'IL'; platform: 'shopify'|'other'|'unknown'; platformConfidence: 'verified'|'likely'|'unknown';
  sourceType: 'manual'|'spreadsheet_import'|'referral'; sourceReference?: string;
  stage: ProspectStage; ownerUid?: string; linkedOrgId?: string; linkedRequestId?: string;
  outreachEligibility: OutreachEligibility; eligibilityReviewedBy?: string; eligibilityReviewedAt?: Timestamp;
  permissionEvidenceUrl?: string; permissionNote?: string; doNotContact: boolean;
  nextAction?: string; nextActionAt?: Timestamp; fitScore?: number; fitReason?: string;
  lastAuditedAt?: Timestamp; lastVerifiedAt?: Timestamp;
  createdBy: string; createdAt: Timestamp; updatedAt: Timestamp;
}
```
Subcollections:
- `findings/{findingId}`: code/category, severity, business relevance, `observedUrl`, text excerpt/screenshot reference, observation time, `evidenceType` (`html`/`visual`/`manual`), `confidence`, `verificationStatus` (`unverified`/`verified`/`rejected`/`stale`), reviewer/time. Never claim hidden HTML is user-visible without screenshot confirmation.
- `contacts/{contactId}`: `name?`, `role?`, `businessEmail?`, `professionalProfileUrl?`, `officialContactUrl?`, `sourceUrl`, `observedAt`, `confidence`, `isPersonalData`, `verifiedBy?`, `verifiedAt?`, `contactStatus` (candidate/verified/invalid/deletion_requested). Never generate/guess addresses, scrape personal phone numbers, or conflate publication with permission.
- `activities/{activityId}`: timestamp, actorUid, type, notes, old/new stage, linked proposal, recorded consent/source. Append-only through authenticated API.

Separate optional `agency_prospect_scan_runs/{scanId}`: prospectId, requestedBy, start/end, safe bounded config, status, page counts, refusal/error codes, cost counters; no full HTML or sensitive cookies retained.

Identity: use deterministic normalized domain ID for first import (after validating actual canonical merchant domain); maintain aliases for verified `myshopify.com` names; upsert idempotently and avoid duplicate client/prospect records. Existing inbound lead with same domain produces a suggested manual match — do not merge consent/state automatically.

## 6. Scan & business contact discovery

**MVP is explicitly manual/on-demand**, not an autonomous internet crawler.

1. Operator supplies an approved domain or bounded CSV. Preflight domain/URL, publicly visible Shopify signals, robots.txt and website terms. Disallowed or uncertain pages are skipped and flagged.
2. Server-side fetch **only** public pages; default cap 6 pages/site (homepage, 1 collection, 1 product, About, Contact, Team if available); throttle ≤1 req/2 seconds/host, no concurrent scans for one host, timeouts, max body size and audit rate quotas. No checkout submission, password entry, form submission, hidden endpoints, robots bypass, captcha bypass or authenticated pages.
3. Reuse analyzer functions selectively; avoid invoking full Lighthouse/Puppeteer for each store by default. Extract deterministic issues first: clearly missing translation keys, broken internal links, inconsistent policies, content-type mismatches, visible CTA accessibility candidates. Some findings require separate visual confirmation. Store concise evidence + timestamps only. No unsupported 'revenue loss' claims.
4. Contact discovery from the site's public About/Team/Contact pages, explicit business-schema entries and **official** partner/supplier channels. Identify buying role rather than insist on a named person. Do not crawl LinkedIn profiles or use email-pattern guessing. Record source and verification date.
5. Require human confirmation of relevance, facts, fit, contact and eligibility before queueing to Adi.
6. Flag old evidence stale after 14 days until reverified. For pilot, auto-removal/minimization review after 90 days for stale findings; personal contact records require a documented retention period and deletion flow. Suppression records retain only the minimum needed to prevent re-contact.

**Security:** current `safe-store-fetch.ts` checks host DNS and manual redirects but is not by itself a fully hardened crawler permission/sandbox system. Before any multi-page operation, cover DNS rebinding, alternate IP encodings, IPv4-mapped IPv6, redirects to internal hosts, metadata endpoints, deceptive ports, public suffix canonicalization, max response bytes and pinned network resolution / controlled egress. Add explicit robots policy checks and no untrusted HTML → prompt-instruction execution. No unreviewed third-party AI processing of personal contact fields.

## 7. Contact legality and outreach policy

- Separate **contact discoverability** from **permission to market**. A published business email/contact form is not opt-in.
- Default `review_required` / `unknown`; only human authorized reviewer may change eligibility with evidence; `blocked` and opt-outs win.
- Israel's Communications Law §30A generally requires prior consent for promotional email/SMS; a narrowly defined one-time business request for consent is **not** blanket permission to pitch. Contact forms are not an automatic loophole.
- Check GDPR/German controller obligations and Israeli privacy rules where applicable; legal review needed before any outbound workflow.
- Product MVP provides contact details, manual next action and copyable **internal research brief** — **no Send button, mailto campaign, contact-form automation, enrichment credits or bulk outreach**. Future send functionality is an independent gated project after legal sign-off, explicit consent records, unsubscribe/suppression enforcement and tests.
- Sources: Israel §30A legislative text https://knesset-tracker.co.il/knesset/statute/2000002 ; Israeli Privacy Protection Authority amendment-13 Q&A https://www.gov.il/he/pages/tikun13_qa?chapterIndex=6 .

## 8. API & security contract

Proposed authenticated routes, all server-side validated Zod, explicit role/field allowlists, audit log, pagination:
- `GET/POST /api/portal/agency/prospects` list/create or import preview.
- `GET/PATCH /api/portal/agency/prospects/[prospectId]` details, allowed stage/owner/next-action changes.
- `POST /api/portal/agency/prospects/[prospectId]/scan` manual, bounded, idempotent; **never** send outreach.
- `POST /api/portal/agency/prospects/[prospectId]/review` founder technical/contact eligibility decisions.
- `POST /api/portal/agency/prospects/[prospectId]/activities` append-only notes/events.
- `POST /api/portal/agency/prospects/import/preview` validate/dedupe before confirmed import.

Firestore rules: deny all client access; deny direct client writes for server-owned prospect collections and subcollections; use `requireAgencySession` with **explicit** owner/admin/sales-manager operation checks in server code (existing helper is broad), and rate limits. Ensure server request is not authorized by client-provided ownerUid or agencyRole. Index `stage, ownerUid, nextActionAt`, `canonicalDomain` / `updatedAt` only as queries need. Sensitive data never exposed in public routes or telemetry.

## 9. Implementation slices (each releasable)

**P0 — revenue-first, 1–2 developer days target:** add private prospect data model, manual create/import preview from existing spreadsheet, dedupe, triage list & detail, source/verification flags, owner/next action. Do not scan automatically. Adi can use it immediately; alternatively work from existing Google Sheet until P0 ships.

**P1 — bounded shop audit:** one manually triggered safe crawl per prospect; deterministic evidence with confidence, reviewer status, cheap per-site limits, skipped/error states; tests for SSRF/robots. No PageSpeed by default.

**P2 — business-contact research:** retrieve only official/public company contact/role clues from allowed pages; provenance + confidence; manual confirmation, channel-eligibility + suppression; never send automatically.

**P3 — sales-to-revenue handoff:** activity timeline, reminder date, `sales_manager` work queue, role-safe founder technical review, links to existing proposal/request/paid revenue; basic funnel metrics per source. Conversion does not imply cash collected.

**P4 (after pilot metrics):** scheduled scans, optional AI-assisted issue summarization, external enrichment integrations or deeper visual snapshots — separately justified by performance, compliance and budget; none in MVP.

## 10. Acceptance / security tests

- Import the existing 14-company research sheet to **preview**, manually approve records, normalize duplicate domains, preserve original evidence URLs and 2026-10-08 observation dates, **no scan or outreach** on import.
- Unknown Shopify identification stays `unknown`; non-Shopify candidates not inaccurately tagged Shopify.
- Unsupported/hidden DOM text is never displayed as verified customer-visible issue.
- Disallowed robots/host/redirects and internal addresses are blocked even after redirect/DNS transition.
- One domain cannot trigger duplicate simultaneous scans; quotas/timeouts/errors are user-visible without crashing the queue.
- Discovery never generates an email address; a role-only contact is acceptable.
- All contacts require source URLs, dates, and privacy-aware retention/deletion.
- Public or client auth cannot read or mutate prospect contacts/findings; sales_manager cannot approve technical scope or change legal gate; unauthorized reviewer actions 403.
- Suppressed prospect cannot transition to contact-ready; no send/marketing job is created by any scan/import.
- Existing inbound marketing dashboard, analyzer, client roles and proposal/payment flows remain unchanged.
- Hebrew RTL + English translation coverage; desktop/mobile and keyboard QA.
- Unit tests (Vitest), route auth tests, Firestore emulator rules, dry-run fixture scan. **No CI reruns or Vercel preview deployments during planning.**

## 11. Review questions / decisions before writing product code

1. Confirm **Adi as sales_manager** (rather than broader agency admin) and founder-only approval of technical + contact eligibility gates.
2. Confirm initial **Israel-only, Shopify-first, manual import + on-demand scans**; no bulk prospect messaging.
3. Agree to a **14-day commercial pilot** before any heavy automation; track real conversations and cash results.
4. Legal reviewer determines if/how business-consent requests can lawfully be conducted; engineering must not infer permission.

**Deliverable of this issue:** reviewable architecture + milestone plan. Once approved, write a repository spec in `docs/superpowers/specs/` and a test-first implementation plan in `docs/superpowers/plans/` before code changes.

comments.author: yotamon
comments.text:
## Implementation slices linked to this design proposal

- #58 **P0 / first release:** private prospects workspace, manual/CSV import, deduplication, owner/next-action triage and role-safety. Can help Adi within the current sales window.
- #59 **P1:** bounded Shopify store audit with observable evidence, crawler policy and SSRF/robots protections.
- #60 **P2:** official business-contact discovery, cited sources, human eligibility review, suppression/deletion and no outbound automation.
- #61 **P3:** Adi's work queue, founder technical review, proposal/paid-revenue handoff and funnel analytics.

**Release order:** P0 → P1 → P2 → P3. Start the *commercial* pilot from the existing spreadsheet while building P0; do not block client acquisition on new automation. P1/P2 may share the same safe page-fetch layer. Each slice has independent tests. Design review is required before product code or external scans begin.

**Cost envelope:** existing Next.js/Firebase/React Query stack; no new paid enrichment, automatic scheduled crawling, mass emailing, Vercel previews or CI reruns in planning.

comments.text:
### Implementation started — branch-only MVP
Feature branch: [feat/prospect-intelligence-mcp-mvp](https://github.com/CartShift/CartShift-Studio/tree/feat/prospect-intelligence-mcp-mvp). Added server-owned `agency_prospects` and distinct `prospects:read/write` MCP scopes; existing inbound marketing leads and email automations are untouched. Added bilingual agency Prospects list/manual create and sourcing/evidence UI. Technical findings and business-contact candidates remain **unverified** with **no outreach approval**. See #62 for MCP work; #59 safe scanner and automatic business-contact discovery still blocked on safety/verification. No merge/deploy or direct outbound actions. Checked syntax for 13 TypeScript files using local Node; full tests not yet run.

comments.author: yotamon
comments.text:
### Updated implementation handoff — 2026-10-14
Branch: https://github.com/CartShift/CartShift-Studio/tree/feat/prospect-intelligence-mcp-mvp
The intended P0–P3 workflow now exists on the feature branch: private domain-deduped leads, bounded HTTPS/robots on-demand scans, source-backed candidate findings and public business contacts, founder verification + legal eligibility gates, Adi assignment/next action, and linkage to existing real proposal records. No automated outbound marketing. The implementation has not been merged or deployed; operator/launch gates: docs/PROSPECT_INTELLIGENCE_OPERATIONS.md. Local verification: 56 focused Vitest tests passed (12 files); TypeScript and focused ESLint clean after fixing JSX and missing ownerUid. Not yet done: live canary, Firestore emulator, visual agency QA, legal/retention and OAuth reauthorization. Avoid preview/CI until release review.
